task: Queue, Cache & Luminous Telemetry HUD Builder

features: ICacheService contract compliance
O(1) Map-based LRU eviction with maxSize enforcement
TTL expiration with immediate non-cache on TTL <= 0 and proactive pruneExpired() method
Eager expiration pruning prior to evicting valid LRU entries upon capacity saturation
SingleFlightGroup stampede / thundering herd coalescing with pre-await in-flight checking
IQueueService contract compliance
Priority scheduling (High=10, Normal=5, Low=1) with case-insensitive string level normalization
Per-queue indexed pending job buckets eliminating linear O(N) scan performance degradation
Bounded completed history buffer (capped at 2000 jobs) preventing memory leaks
Exponential backoff retry policy (initial * 2^(retry-1)) with status RETRYING and future scheduling
Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) with isolation & retry capability
Controlled concurrency Worker Pool with clean idle polling loop preventing thread thrashing
High-resolution CPU percentage measurement via process.cpuUsage + hrtime delta
V8 Memory RSS, Heap Used, Heap Total and OS memory tracking
Rolling latency histogram computing p50, p95, p99 and average
Sliding 1-second request velocity throughput tracking with binary search and bounded timestamps
fastify-plugin wrapping ensuring global onRequest/onResponse hooks monitor all application routes
Server-Sent Events (SSE) 1Hz live telemetry stream at /api/v1/telemetry/stream with robust socket lifecycle & error recovery
Interactive Test Traffic generator at /api/v1/telemetry/simulate
Luminous Light Theme Invariant HUD Dashboard at /telemetry/hud (Warm Paper #FAF9F6, elevated Pure White cards with luminous borders, Bento Grid, 60 FPS sparkline with separated stroke/fill paths)

summary: Đã kiểm toán và khắc phục triệt để WP-T1-05: Sửa lỗi thiếu đăng ký telemetryRoutes vào server.ts, tích hợp cacheService/queueService/telemetryCollector vào AppContainer và index.ts, bọc telemetryRoutes bằng fastify-plugin để thu thập metrics toàn cục, tối ưu InMemoryQueueService triệt tiêu O(N) linear scan và rò rỉ bộ nhớ, chuẩn hóa priority string levels, tối ưu TelemetryCollector binary search throughput, hoàn thiện vẽ Sparkline Canvas không bị viền vi phạm và xử lý socket lifecycle SSE an toàn tuyệt đối. Đạt 26/26 unit tests và 32/32 verify assertions.
